name: El Rosal (Colombia)
description: Red field with a green canton and a green lower-fly panel and a red lower-hoist panel, separated by white lines forming an off-centre cross.
history: Municipal flag of El Rosal, a municipality in the department of Cundinamarca, Colombia; Spanish Wikipedia records that the municipal symbols were adopted by Decree 047 of 25 September 1999, the design abstracting the town's position at a crossroads.

features.role: white lines forming an off-centre cross
